proof_body:
by
  intro E _ _ _ f a _
  constructor
  · intro v hv
    rw [← inner_gradient_left]
    calc inner ℝ (gradient f a) v ≤ ‖gradient f a‖ * ‖v‖ := real_inner_le_norm _ _
      _ = ‖gradient f a‖ := by rw [hv, mul_one]
  · intro hne
    have hn : ‖gradient f a‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hne
    constructor
    · rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn]
    · rw [← inner_gradient_left, inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
      field_simp
target_source: ∀ (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (f : E → ℝ) (a : E), DifferentiableAt ℝ f a → (∀ v : E, ‖v‖ = 1 → fderiv ℝ f a v ≤ ‖gradient f a‖) ∧ (gradient f a ≠ 0 → ‖(‖gradient f a‖)⁻¹ • gradient f a‖ = 1 ∧ fderiv ℝ f a ((‖gradient f a‖)⁻¹ • gradient f a) = ‖gradient f a‖)
